messages:
emma: Opening a follow-up thread for Gossamer Dedicated outage. Root cause: intermittent on-prem NAT device + stale BGP routes caused session pinning and tenant isolation for ~1.5hrs. Need concrete remediations and an owner per action. Adding folks who were on the incident.

ravi: Quick summary from network postmortem: NAT sessions exhausted when their appliance hit a connection-tracking bug; combined with a BGP flap the routes were not reinstalled quickly. Two vectors: onprem appliance bug + missing guardrails in our peering health checks.

lyn: I'm happy to own the checklist and monitoring pieces. Proposed immediate work: (1) add a health-check that validates route presence + management plane reachability; (2) create an escalation for stale routes >90s; (3) add a customer preflight that verifies conntrack thresholds. ETA suggestions inside.

joel: For appliance bug, Gossamer is running firmware 9.2.1 which has known conntrack leak (see vendor KB 2156). They agreed to schedule an upgrade but requested a mitigation we can apply from our side in the meantime. I can propose a session-scaling config and a temporary connection-throttle on our egress to reduce state pressure.

emma: Action list draft (owner -> ETA):
- joel -> draft mitigation config + test plan -> 2026-04-06
- lyn -> monitoring healthcheck + alert playbook -> 2026-04-02
- ravi -> add a "stale-route detection" lambda + incident template -> 2026-04-04
- emma -> customer comms + upgrade coordination -> 2026-04-03
- infra-team -> bulk sweep: run conntrack threshold audit across Dedicated tenants -> 2026-04-15

lyn: Monitoring details: propose heartbeat every 30s: fetch BGP adjacency and validate prefix presence via our peering API. If mismatch > 2 polls -> create a P0 oncall page + runbook hint "attempt MGMT fallback -> trigger remote validation". I'll mock the alert noise in staging first.

ravi: I'll add the lambda to detect prefix disappearance and attach an automated incident draft. Sketch of logic: poll peer, compare advertised prefixes vs expected; if missing -> create incident with tags {customer:gossamer, type:peering, severity:page}. PR to infra repo when ready.

joel: mitigation PR: https://repo.redwood.internal/security/merge/9010 (draft). Config snippet included in PR description. Manual test in lab reduced simultaneous conntrack spikes by 60% during synthetic load.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 2026-04-05-441 created: Gossamer Dedicated intermittent isolation. Follow-ups assigned. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2026/441

emma: Two procedural items: (A) add a line in private-deploy onboarding that we record onprem NAT model + conntrack limits (owner: lyn -> 2026-04-07); (B) add a retro ticket reminding SRE rotations to run tenant sweeps monthly (owner: infra-team -> 2026-04-20).

lyn: I'll open the checklist PR and include a simple test script to query conntrack counters when we provision a customer. PR ETA 2026-04-07.

joel: Gossamer agreed to upgrade firmware next week (scheduled 2026-04-11 02:00-03:00 UTC). We'll coordinate a short maintenance window and run our health checks during the change. I recommend a canary first: run upgrade on one PoP then observe for 24h.

emma: Noted. Assigning canary owner: joel. Canary validation steps: pre-check, upgrade, post-checks, 24h observation, rollback plan. Please post the checklist in this thread once ready.

ravi: small ops automation note: adding a 1-click runbook action that calls our MGMT fallback steps would save time during pages. I'll prototype that after the lambda lands. ETA prototype -> 2026-04-10.

ops-bot: Follow-up reminder set: 2026-04-08 10:00 PT -> "Gossamer remediation sync". Ticket: INC-2026-441-A

lyn: Validation in staging for healthcheck done; false positives tuned out by adjusting poll intervals and requiring 2 consecutive misses. Pushed a staging dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/staging/gossamer-peering (internal).

joel: Prod mitigation applied temporarily during the maintenance window; post-upgrade we saw conntrack counts stabilize and no route loss across the canary PoP. Will handoff full rollout to Gossamer mid-next-week.

emma: Great. Closing notes: consolidate all action items into the central remediation board and set the "recurring pattern" flag if we see similar nat/conntrack incidents in other tenants. If pattern is confirmed, prioritize a platform-level guardrail. Thanks all.

ravi: I'll mark the incident follow-ups as "in progress" and update statuses daily until closed. Reopening thread if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
